name: Factory
note: Here, you have various modules available. You can uncheck the modules you do not want to use.

modules.name: Products/ Inventory/ Stock Management
modules.description: Tracks and controls stock levels, categories, product variants, location in the warehouse, and shipping.

modules.name: Fixed Asset Management
modules.description: Effortlessly track, control, and report on your organization’s fixed assets. Enables you to monitor asset inventory, categories, variants, locations, and shipping logistics, while also providing reporting capabilities for asset appreciation and depreciation. Simplify the management of valuable resources and gain insights into the financial performance of your assets.

modules.name: Stock Report
modules.description: List stock item's quantity available in a particular warehouse. multiple Stock reports, including Sales, Quotations, Purchases, Sale and Purchase Returns, Transfers, as well as Adjustments.

modules.name: Barcode Printing
modules.description: Allows you to print barcodes directly from the Drongo ERP database for each product plus any quantity, improving the error rate of the labels, reducing misprints, and significantly reducing the amount of data entry required to generate labels

modules.name: Stock Alert Report
modules.description: Lists stock item’s quantity available in a particular warehouse.

modules.name: Raw Material Management
modules.description: Efficiently track raw material usage, minimize wastage, and trace their transformation into finished products with our Raw Material Management module, offered at no cost. Enhance manufacturing processes, optimize resource utilization, and gain valuable insights for improved cost-effectiveness within your ERP system

modules.name: Product Report
modules.description: Analyze product sales and revenue in chosen time frames (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly). Focus on specific warehouses. Exportable in PDF and Excel. Gain valuable insights for inventory management and business growth.

modules.name: Sales Management
modules.description: Implements sales placement, sales scheduling, shipping, status and invoicing.

modules.name: Sales Report
modules.description: Reports sales of all products and analyzes sales data.

modules.name: Shipment and Delivery Status
modules.description: Tracks the progress of shipments, delivery times, and order status updates, ensuring accurate timelines and customer notifications.

modules.name: Sales Return Tracking
modules.description: When sold Item being returned. Manages and identifies product, customer, warehouse, date, it’s effect on stock as well as revenue and its status.

modules.name: Point of Sale (POS)
modules.description: Easiest way of selling and navigating through products. Displays products with image, quantity as well as price & enables selling with barcode support.

modules.name: Product Sales Report
modules.description: Track total product sales by warehouse, customer, and date. Filterable and exportable in PDF and Excel. Gain insights into sales quantity and grand total. Inform your business decisions with this powerful reporting module.

modules.name: Purchases Return Tracking
modules.description: When purchased Item being returned. Manages and identifies product, supplier, warehouse, date, effect on stock and its status.

modules.name: Purchases Quotation
modules.description: Enables creating and managing supplier quotations, listing items with costs, quantities, and delivery terms for procurement comparison. Helps streamline supplier selection and cost estimation for purchasing decisions.

modules.name: Product Purchases Report
modules.description: Track total product purchases by warehouse, supplier, and date. Filterable and exportable in PDF and Excel. Gain insights into purchase quantity and grand total. Optimize costs and make informed decisions with this powerful reporting module.

modules.name: Purchase Report
modules.description: Reports purchases made for various products focusing mainly on quantity, total cost, product supply , chain status, and payment status incurred to buy that quantity for a preferred date range.

modules.name: Purchases & Supply Chain
modules.description: Maximize cost saving with support for the end-to-end procurement and logistics processes.

modules.name: Payment Method Management
modules.description: Facilitates the management of various payment methods, allowing organizations to streamline transactions, track payment processing, and ensure secure financial operations across multiple channels.

modules.name: Trial Balance Report
modules.description: Displays a summary of all ledger accounts with their respective balances, ensuring that total debits equal total credits for accurate financial reporting.

modules.name: General Ledger Report
modules.description: Presents a comprehensive record of all transactions in a standardized format, enabling easy tracking and review of financial activities within the general ledger.

modules.name: Payroll Management
modules.description: Automates payroll preparation for employees, ensuring compliance with government regulations and incorporating allowances, while streamlining calculations for timely and accurate salary disbursement.

modules.name: Monetary Transaction Tracking
modules.description: Manages the movement of funds through loans, revenues from auxiliary services, and other activities beyond core operations, providing detailed oversight for financial health and reporting.

modules.name: General Ledger and Trial Balance
modules.description: Maintains a comprehensive record of all financial transactions, facilitating the creation of a Trial Balance to ensure the accuracy and completeness of accounts, supporting effective financial reporting and analysis.

modules.name: Owner's Withdrawal Management
modules.description: Manages owner withdrawals based on their contributions while ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, facilitating accurate tracking and equitable distribution of profits.

modules.name: Bank Account Management
modules.description: Enables the creation and management of bank accounts while recording transaction movements, ensuring accurate financial tracking and reconciliation for better cash flow management.

modules.name: Cash on Hand Management
modules.description: Oversees cash revenues and petty cash transactions, ensuring accurate tracking, secure handling, and efficient reconciliation for effective cash flow management.

modules.name: All Tax Management
modules.description: Tracks all tax obligations related to the organization and employees, including VAT, withholding, income tax, and others to ensuring reconciliation and monitoring of payment statuses for compliance and accuracy.

modules.name: Payments Report
modules.description: Reports payments on purchase, sales, sales return and purchase return. Also reports how much, how, when, and who paid.

modules.name: Financial Statement
modules.description: Prepares key financial documents, including Profit and Loss statements, Owner's Equity statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow statements, ensuring compliance with government regulations and standards for accurate financial reporting.

modules.name: Bill of Material (BOM)
modules.description: Manage raw material requests for production, return unused materials, and address shortages to ensure efficient production processes.

modules.name: Maintenance Management
modules.description: Handles defect tracking and issue resolution for equipment, machinery, and factory assets, ensuring timely maintenance and minimizing downtime.

modules.name: Manufacturing Order Management
modules.description: This module streamlines manufacturing orders by setting start and finish dates, selecting warehouses, and specifying products. It tracks order items, manages costs (overhead, labor, shipping), and monitors stock levels. Users can define manufacturing steps and responsible staff for efficient production workflows.

modules.name: Manufacturing Report
modules.description: Provides a comprehensive overview of the production process, detailing raw material usage, production output, labor costs, and efficiency metrics to assess manufacturing performance and identify areas for improvement.

modules.name: Process Setting Management
modules.description: This module manages and organizes process lists, defining manufacturing steps along with their respective time requirements for efficient workflow planning and execution.

modules.name: Customer and Supplier Management
modules.description: Manages relationships with customers and suppliers, tracking interactions, order history, and performance metrics to enhance collaboration, improve service quality, and drive business efficiency.

modules.name: Users / Staff Report
modules.description: Reports which employees purchased and sold what products. And which employee created (quotations, return sales, return purchases, transfers and adjustments).

modules.name: Supplier Report
modules.description: Reports your purchases from suppliers', payments, amounts owed and paid (Credit report), as well as returned purchases.

modules.name: Best Customer Report / Customer Report
modules.description: Reports purchases made for various products focusing mainly on quantity, total cost, product supply , chain status, and payment status incurred to buy that quantity for a preferred date range.

modules.name: Attendance, Leave, and Holiday Tracking
modules.description: Monitors employee attendance, manages leave requests, and tracks holidays, ensuring accurate records for payroll and compliance while facilitating workforce management.

modules.name: Department and Designation Tracking
modules.description: Facilitates the management of organizational structure by tracking departments and employee designations, ensuring clarity in roles, responsibilities, and reporting relationships across the organization.

modules.name: Employee, Shift, and Allowance Management
modules.description: Streamlines employee management by tracking work shifts, managing allowances, and ensuring accurate compensation while optimizing workforce scheduling and compliance.

modules.name: Transfer Report
modules.description: This report details the transfer of products between warehouses, highlighting the quantities of items transferred and their corresponding values.

modules.name: Transfer and Logistics Tracking
modules.description: Manages the movement of products between branches and keeps track of their status.

modules.name: Target and KPI Tracking
modules.description: Establishes and monitors targets and corresponding Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for various departments and projects, based on defined roles and criteria, to drive performance and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.

modules.name: Performance Management
modules.description: Tracks employee and project performance by comparing targets and plans with actual outcomes, facilitating recognition and rewards based on achievements to drive motivation and accountability.

addons.name: Profit & Loss Report
addons.description: A financial report that shows a company’s Sales, Purchases, Sales Return, Purchases Return, Expenses, revenues and Profit, Payments Received, Payments Sent, and Payments Net over a given time period.

addons.name: Daily Backup
addons.description: Sending a copy of your virtual file or database to a secondary, off-site location for preservation in case of equipment failure or catastrophe.

addons.name: Adjustment and Modification
addons.description: This report details adjustments made to inventory, including additions or subtractions of goods from stock, to ensure accurate inventory management and tracking.

addons.name: Marketing Management
addons.description: Comprehensive marketing module to manage campaigns, integrate social media, execute email marketing, and gather actionable insights through analytics and customer feedback. Includes tools for event management, marketing budgeting, forecasting, and managing referral & loyalty programs. Supports geographical analysis of sales data to optimize marketing strategies and customer outreach efforts.

addons.name: Expenses Management
addons.description: Assists you in keeping track of business spending. It facilitates in budget management and expense optimization for your business.

addons.name: Warehouse Management/report
addons.description: Sending a copy of your virtual file or database to a secondary, off-site location for preservation in case of equipment failure or catastrophe.

addons.name: Knowledge Base Management
addons.description: Centralize knowledge base articles and categories to help new employees understand the company's vision, mission, and goals. Easily categorize and search content for efficient knowledge sharing and support.
